---
title: Severity by age, as a function
jupyter: python3
---

Some parts of a model are easiest to write as a function. Here the chance that an infection is severe enough for hospital depends on age: 10% under 50, and 40% from 50 up. Rather than stratify the disease by age and give a value for each group, the chance is a Python function of the sim, which reads people's ages. Starsim tries the function on the model's age groups, and since it works on them, the model still runs as compartments; run as agents, the same function is evaluated for each person.

## The model

| Parameter | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| β | 0.3 per day | Rate of infection |
| Infectious period | 7 days | Mean time in I (exponential), before hospital or recovery |
| Hospitalized | 10% under 50, 40% from 50 up | From a function of age |
| Stay in hospital | 10 days | Mean time to discharge |
| Age groups | 0–49, 50+ | For the compartmental run |
| Population | 10,000 | |
| Infectious at the start | 0.1% | |

```{python}
import starsim as ss
ss.options(jupyter=True)

def severity(sim):
    """ The chance of hospitalization: 10%, plus 30% from age 50 """
    return 0.1 + 0.3*(sim.people.age >= 50)

S, I, H, R = ss.states('S I H R')
infection = S >> I @ 0.3*I
course    = ss.Transition(I, [H, R], p=severity, dur=ss.days(7))
discharge = H >> R @ ss.days(10)
flu = ss.Disease(infection, course, discharge, init=dict(I=0.001), name='flu')
```

The diagram, from `diagram()`:

```{python}
flu.diagram()
```

## Result

The sim is split into two age groups at 50 (`stratify=dict(age=[0, 50])`), so that the function has ages to work on in a compartmental run. The same model is run as an ODE and as agents:

```{python}
sims = {
    'ODE': ss.Sim(flu, total_pop=10_000, stop=ss.days(100), stratify=dict(age=[0, 50]), verbose=0),
    'Agents': ss.Sim(flu, total_pop=10_000, stop=ss.days(100), solver='abm', verbose=0),
}
msim = ss.parallel(sims)
msim.plot('flu')
```

The two agree, apart from chance in the agent run. Of about 8,000 infections, about 1,400 people are admitted to hospital (`flu_course.H`): one in six, between the 10% of those under 50 and the 40% of those over, since about a quarter of people are 50 or over (the population's ages are guessed as the world's in 2024, as `describe()` says):

```{python}
msim.summarize().loc[['flu_infection', 'flu_course.H']]
```

A function that needs each person (one that takes `uids`, the people it applies to, as well as the sim) can't be run as compartments, so Starsim runs a model with one as agents, and `describe()` says why.
